thread:
Anna (Sales): Kicking off POC for FinEdge. Need quick sizing + cost for a 4-week pilot. Customer: 10k DAU, expect 3 calls/user/day, avg ~60 tokens/request, bursts to ~600 RPS. SOC2 + VPC, no persistent logs. Start target in ~2 weeks.
Maria (SE): Got it. Quick clarifying q: are outputs sensitive (PII) or can we send to hosted infra?
Anna (Sales): Outputs may include user names and transaction references -> must stay in VPC, KMS for keys, no third-party logging.
Devon (Infra Eng): For those constraints we should plan Private or Dedicated. Quick reqs: 200 RPS sustained, spikes to 600. Latency SLO target: 95th < 500ms.
Kai (SRE): Token math first: 10k * 3 * 60 = 1,800,000 tokens/day -> ~54M tokens/month. For the 200 RPS sustained case: 200 * 60 = 12k tokens/sec.
Maria (SE): Throughput rough numbers (quantized/optimized runtime): A10G ~= 1.2k tokens/s, A100-80GB ~= 4k tokens/s (model-dependent). So for sustained 12k t/s -> ~10 A10G equivalents or ~3 A100s.
Anna (Sales): That's above their stated pilot budget (~$12k). Any lower-cost approaches for the POC?
Maria (SE): Options: 1) Start smaller with sampling / heavy prefix caching for common prompts, 2) use smaller model variant for non-critical queries, 3) staged ramp + hosted fallback for overflow. For POC, recommend hybrid: 1 A100 reserved for critical traffic + autoscale ephemeral A10G instances for bursts.
Devon (Infra Eng): Cost sketch (cloud-equivalents): A100 ~$25/hr, A10G ~$6/hr. If we reserve 1 A100 for 12h/day and allow ~4 A10G burst pool on-demand, pilot infra cost estimate ~ $10-13k for 4 weeks. Platform + token usage add ~ $2-4k depending on token pricing. Total ~ $13k-$17k.
Anna (Sales): Good — that fits their range if we sell as "staged ramp". Need concrete success criteria to include in the SOW.
Jess (PM): Suggest success criteria: 1) 95th latency < 500ms for production traffic profile during the staging week, 2) End-to-end P99 error rate < 1%, 3) Cost per 1M tokens < $280 for pilot, 4) Quality: >= 90% pass rate on a 200-prompt eval set (automated metrics + 20 manual checks), 5) VPC & KMS validated with no data egress.
Maria (SE): I'll author the 200-prompt eval (mix of short queries, long contexts, and edge cases). We'll create automatic scoring (BLEU/ROUGE + rule-based checks) and a manual QA checklist.
Anna (Sales): Customer also asked about SLA during pilot and rollback plan.
Devon (Infra Eng): We'll include runbook: provisioning (3 business days), routing + canary (5 days), monitoring hooks (tracing + token-level cost), and rollback to smaller model or hosted fallback.
Kai (SRE): Load test plan snippet:
```
heyload --rps 200 --duration 10m --payload-file=pilot_prompts.json --concurrency 50
```
Maria (SE): Example prompt eval snippet (we'll use these as the canonical prompts for scoring):
```
{"prompt": "Summarize this transaction for customer support: acct 4321 charged $23.45 for order #9876", "expected": "Charge of $23.45 on order #9876"}
```
Anna (Sales): Ops/security questions from FinEdge: detailed key handling, audit log retention, data residency. I'll send their questionnaire; we need answers in 2 business days.
Maria (SE): I'll handle technical answers for KMS, no-logs mode, and retention windows.
Devon (Infra Eng): Note: VPC peering and KMS policy will need networking approval; allow 2-3 days to complete.
Presales Bot: reserved_capacity provisioned: staging-rc-99321 (status: pending)
Anna (Sales): Thanks team — I'll package this as the POC proposal and follow up with the questionnaire. Target start: next Wednesday if provisioning clears. :thumbsup:
